done_when: From an item's second review round, review checks only the previous round's findings and the lines changed since that review; a new finding in unchanged code becomes a follow-up unless it is a security or data-loss problem; and a Not done finding blocks only against an owner-approved Done-when item, never a builder detail; in Forge's repo and in client repos, new and upgraded

known.title: Security findings identified by category can become nonblocking follow-ups
Not done: Deleting a line can make an unchanged finding block the next review
Gate: client guide proof does not check the Not done rule
Answered second-round question keeps replacing the next work step
A locally started base gives dependent parts a circular next step

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — After two blocked reviews, the guide tells the coordinator to record the owner's rule in the plan and send one focused round. This function clears its advice only when `stop.choice` exists, but the guide says that choice is recorded only after a later hard stop. Recording the rule therefore leaves `blocked_rounds` at two, and `nextstep._item` returns the same owner question before it can show the work step. The normal `forge next` flow keeps asking an already-answered question.
findings.title: Answered second-round question keeps replacing the next work step

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional — Starting part A creates a local task branch before its first review publishes a remote branch. `_started` includes A, so starting dependent part B reaches this remote-only check and reports that A has not started, with `Next: forge task start A`; that command instead refuses because A is already started. For the same state, `forge next` says A must publish reviewed changes but gives `Next: forge next`, which repeats the message. Neither path tells the coordinator how to advance the started base.
findings.title: A locally started base gives dependent parts a circular next step

stop.reason: Owner: fix only the stuck next step after an answered stop question (src/forge/review.py). The circular next step for dependent parts is out of scope; the merged stack-circular-next fix on main covers it.

why: Close reviews take 4 to 9 rounds on code parts because every round reviews afresh and finds new edge cases, and builder details block as Not done
